  100 ;UNISPRITE. (C) 1989,WLODEK BLACK, MOSCOW.
  110 ;---------
  120 ; CALLING: LD HL,<ADDR. OF SPRITE ATTR.TABLE>
  130 ; CALL SPRPUT OR CALL SPRDEL
  140 ; RETURN PARAMETERS: CARRY FLAG=1 - OK, =0 (NC) - ERROR;
  150 ; OLDX,OLDY = NEW COORDS.
  160 ;-----------------------
  170 ; STRUCTURE OF SPRITE ATTRIBUTE TABLE:
  180 ; DEFB XSPR - 0...255 FROM LEFT SIDE OF SCREEN - "X" COORD.;
  190 ; DEFB YSPR - 0...191 FROM TOP OF SCREEN; "Y" COORD.;
  200 ; DEFB XSIZE - HORIZONTAL SIZE IN CHAR POSITIONS (NOT POINTS);
  210 ; DEFB YSIZE - VERTICAL SIZE IN LINES OR POINTS (NOT CHARS);
  220 ; DEFW SPRGEN - ADDRESS OF SPRITE GENERATOR TABLE
  230 ; SPR.GEN.TABLE IS BYTES OF SPRITE FROM LEFT TO RIGHT AND FROM 
  240 ; TOP TO DOWN SIMPLY.
  250 ; DEFW BUFPHN - ADDR. OF BUFFER OF OLD SCREEN PICTURE;
  260 ; DEFW BUFSPR - ADDR. OF BUFFER FOR "RR (HL)" OF SPRITE;
  270 ; DEFB OLDX
  280 ; DEFB OLDY - IF SPRITE IS PUTED "OK", THERE ARE ITS NEW COORDS
  290 ; SIZES OF BUFFERS MUST BE >=XSIZE*YSIZE.
  300 ; SET XSPR AND YSPR BEFORE "CALL" AND DON'T TAKE ANOTHER PARAMS
  310 ;--------------------------
  320 SPRPUT JR   SAVPHN
  330 SPRDEL JP   SPRCLR
  340 SAVPHN DI
  350        PUSH IX
  360        PUSH HL
  370        POP  IX
  380        LD   A,(IX+0)
  390        AND  %11111000
  400        RRCA
  410        RRCA
  420        RRCA
  430        LD   (XPOS),A
  440        ADD  A,(IX+2)
  450        CP   33
  460        JP   NC,SPRERR
  470        LD   A,(IX+1)
  480        CP   192
  490        JP   NC,SPRERR
  500        CCF
  510        RLA
  520        LD   C,A
  530        LD   B,0
  540        RL   B
  550        LD   HL,VRAMT
  560        ADD  HL,BC
  570        LD   (YVRAM),HL
  580        LD   A,(IX+1)
  590        ADD  A,(IX+3)
  600        CCF
  610        JP   NC,SPRERR
  620        CP   192
  630        JP   NC,SPRERR
  640        LD   A,(IX+3)
  650        LD   (COUSVY),A
  660        LD   E,(IX+6)
  670        LD   D,(IX+7)
  680 SAVPH1 LD   HL,(YVRAM)
  690        LD   C,(HL)
  700        INC  HL
  710        LD   B,(HL)
  720        LD   A,(XPOS)
  730        LD   L,A
  740        LD   H,0
  750        ADD  HL,BC
  760        LD   C,(IX+2)
  770        LD   B,0
  780        LDIR
  790        LD   HL,(YVRAM)
  800        INC  HL
  810        INC  HL
  820        LD   (YVRAM),HL
  830        LD   A,(COUSVY)
  840        DEC  A
  850        LD   (COUSVY),A
  860        JR   NZ,SAVPH1
  870 ROTSPR LD   E,(IX+3)
  880        LD   D,0
  890        LD   B,(IX+2)
  900        LD   HL,0
  910 ROTSP1 ADD  HL,DE
  920        DJNZ ROTSP1
  930        LD   C,L
  940        LD   B,H
  950        LD   E,(IX+8)
  960        LD   D,(IX+9)
  970        LD   L,(IX+4)
  980        LD   H,(IX+5)
  990        LDIR
 1000        LD   A,(IX+0)
 1010        AND  %111
 1020        JR   Z,PUTSPR
 1030        LD   D,A
 1040 ROTSP4 LD   L,(IX+8)
 1050        LD   H,(IX+9)
 1060        LD   E,(IX+3)
 1070 ROTSP3 LD   B,(IX+2)
 1080        OR   A
 1090 ROTSP2 RR   (HL)
 1100        INC  HL
 1110        DJNZ ROTSP2
 1120        DEC  E
 1130        JR   NZ,ROTSP3
 1140        DEC  D
 1150        JR   NZ,ROTSP4
 1160 PUTSPR LD   C,(IX+1)
 1170        LD   B,0
 1180        OR   A
 1190        RL   C
 1200        RL   B
 1210        LD   HL,VRAMT
 1220        ADD  HL,BC
 1230        LD   (YVRAM),HL
 1240        LD   L,(IX+8)
 1250        LD   H,(IX+9)
 1260        LD   (BFSPOI),HL
 1270        LD   L,(IX+6)
 1280        LD   H,(IX+7)
 1290        LD   (PHNPOI),HL
 1300        LD   A,(IX+3)
 1310        LD   (NUMLIN),A
 1320 PUTLIN LD   HL,(YVRAM)
 1330        LD   C,(HL)
 1340        INC  HL
 1350        LD   B,(HL)
 1360        LD   A,(XPOS)
 1370        LD   L,A
 1380        LD   H,0
 1390        ADD  HL,BC
 1400        LD   (VRMPOI),HL
 1410        XOR  A
 1420        LD   (LPIX),A

 1450        LD   (RPIX),A
 1460 PUTL1  LD   HL,(BFSPOI)

 1480        LD   C,A
 1490        LD   B,0

 1510        XOR  A

 1580 PUTL2  LD   D,(HL)
 1590        LD   HL,(PHNPOI)

 1610        LD   E,(HL)

 1780        CP   (HL)
 1790        JR   NC,ENDLIN

 2100 ASKLIN LD   HL,RPIX
